_comment: Tennessee 2026 QAP, Tennessee Housing Development Agency. Page numbers are PDF page indices, which match the running header 'PAGE -N-' (the table of contents is about four pages off). Section 17 scores two ALTERNATIVE universes: A. New Construction (default track, pp.88-102) and B. Rehabilitation of Existing Multifamily Housing (track rehab, pp.103-117). Each opens: 'The scoring criteria in this section are not intended to allow an Applicant to claim the maximum 100 points.' 100 is recorded as the stated total of both, and the MISMATCH that follows is by the document's own design. Hand-summed before loading. New construction: 4 + 6 + 23 + 7 + 4 + 4 + 4 + 4 + 1 + 5 + 10 + 5 + (11 or 14: 9) + 8 = 94. Rehabilitation: 2 + 13 + 23 + 10 + (5 or 7: 7) + 1 + 10 + 5 + (8 or 11: 10) + 8 = 89. The loader matched both. Minimums: 65 new construction (52 in the PHA General Priority Category), 60 rehabilitation. Several cross-references cite Section 16 for Section 17 items; each is recorded in its note. Thresholds (Section 6) are in TN_thresholds.json.

track_totals.note: New construction. 'The scoring criteria in this section are not intended to allow an Applicant to claim the maximum 100 points.' Computed 94. MISMATCH by design: 100 is the scale, and the document says the criteria do not reach it. Minimum 65 (52 PHA General Priority).
Rehabilitation. Same sentence. Computed 89. MISMATCH by design. Minimum 60.
